roleSummary: A senior engineer who builds and ships production LLM systems: retrieval, agents and evaluation: in Python on AWS, owning work from design through deployment.

dimensions.name: Python depth
dimensions.instructions: Judge professional Python depth: years using Python in paid roles and use of frameworks such as Django or FastAPI. General programming in other languages does not count.

levels.label: None
levels.description: No professional Python mentioned.

levels.label: Basic
levels.description: Python only in scripts, coursework or under two years of professional use.

levels.label: Working
levels.description: Two to five years building Python services or tools in paid roles.

levels.label: Strong
levels.description: Five to seven years; built production services with Django, FastAPI or similar.

levels.label: Expert
levels.description: Seven or more years; designed and owned Python services or libraries used by others.

dimensions.name: Production LLM systems
dimensions.instructions: Judge shipped, user-facing LLM work: RAG, agents, voice or similar. Courses, tutorials and notebooks are not production.

levels.label: None
levels.description: No LLM work mentioned.

levels.label: Basic
levels.description: Courses, tutorials, hackathons or notebooks only.

levels.label: Working
levels.description: Built an internal tool or prototype with an LLM API.

levels.label: Strong
levels.description: Shipped at least one production LLM system used by real users.

levels.label: Expert
levels.description: Shipped several production LLM systems and owned their evaluation and monitoring.

dimensions.name: RAG and prompt engineering
dimensions.instructions: Judge hands-on retrieval work: embeddings, vector databases, chunking, retrieval strategy and prompt design.

levels.label: None
levels.description: No retrieval or prompt engineering mentioned.

levels.label: Basic
levels.description: Mentions RAG or prompts without describing what was built.

levels.label: Working
levels.description: Built a RAG pipeline with an off-the-shelf vector database.

levels.label: Strong
levels.description: Tuned chunking, retrieval and prompts against measured quality.

levels.label: Expert
levels.description: Designed retrieval architectures (hybrid search, reranking) and led prompt evaluation.

dimensions.name: AI ecosystem awareness
dimensions.instructions: Judge evidence of current practice: evals, agentic workflows, MCP, recent models and frameworks, used in real work.

levels.label: None
levels.description: No current AI tooling mentioned.

levels.label: Basic
levels.description: Lists tools or buzzwords without describing their use.

levels.label: Working
levels.description: Used one current framework or eval approach in a project.

levels.label: Strong
levels.description: Regularly uses evals and agentic workflows in delivered work.

levels.label: Expert
levels.description: Builds or contributes to AI tooling, evals or frameworks used by others.

dimensions.name: Cloud and infrastructure
dimensions.instructions: Judge hands-on AWS and deployment work: services used, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code.

levels.label: None
levels.description: No cloud or deployment work mentioned.

levels.label: Basic
levels.description: Deployed to a managed platform without touching infrastructure.

levels.label: Working
levels.description: Deployed services on AWS using Docker.

levels.label: Strong
levels.description: Owned AWS infrastructure with Terraform or Kubernetes in production.

levels.label: Expert
levels.description: Designed cloud architecture and deployment pipelines for multiple teams.

dimensions.name: End-to-end delivery
dimensions.instructions: Judge whether the candidate designs, builds and deploys whole systems rather than one layer.

levels.label: None
levels.description: No evidence of delivering a system.

levels.label: Basic
levels.description: Contributed to one layer of a system built by others.

levels.label: Working
levels.description: Built features across backend and data layers.

levels.label: Strong
levels.description: Designed, built and deployed a complete system.

levels.label: Expert
levels.description: Led several end-to-end systems from design to production operation.

mustHaves.statement: The candidate has 7 or more years of professional Python experience.
The candidate has shipped at least one LLM-based system to production users.
The candidate has hands-on experience deploying services on AWS.

redFlags.statement: The resume lists AI keywords that no role description backs up with concrete work.
All of the candidate's AI work is more than two years old.

fit.instructions: Decide how well the candidate fits the role overall.

options.description: Meets every must-have and shows real, recent AI depth.
Misses one must-have, or AI depth is unclear from the resume.
Misses several must-haves, or AI work is superficial.
